status.en: 4 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Bangui, Arkan and Bambouti.
status.nb: 4 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Bangui, Arkan og Bambouti.

summary.en: Armed clashes continue in Bangui as government forces, former Séléka rebels and Anti-balaka militias fight, with Russian Wagner forces and Africa Corps protecting President Touadéra. Fighting has spread from Sudan into the Central African Republic, prompting the United Nations to warn against a premature withdrawal of peacekeepers. Chad arrested four suspects after an attack in Miski, and France is re-engaging in the Sahel, emphasizing Chad’s strategic importance. The conflict caused 246 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
